test_OffloadManager_context: test the OffloadManager class as a context manager that auto-cleans offloaded model weights on exit
test_OffloadManager_offload_reload: test the OffloadManager offload and reload methods to save and restore model block weights to disk
test_OffloadManager_hooks: test the OffloadManager add_offload_hooks and remove_offload_hooks methods to clear and restore all model blocks
test_clear_module_weights: test the _clear_module_weights function to zero out weight tensors from a PyTorch module while caching original numel
test_AutoScheme_low_cpu_mem: test the AutoScheme dataclass with low_cpu_mem_usage enabled to reduce CPU RAM during model quantization
